concepts.gloss_en: the speech/utterance of Torah and prayer (as opposed to a qualified 'holy' construct)

members.note: plural of the same construct, same referent in same Torah (the dibburim of Torah and prayer); number variation only

concepts.gloss_en: the holy speech (speech of holiness) of Torah and prayer — qualified head adds 'of holiness'

members.note: adds construct modifier דקדשה ('of holiness'); different head-qualification, kept separate per under-merge and construct-head rule

notes: All three appear in lm1:75 and are closely related. Singular/plural merged as number variation. The דקדשה form carries an extra construct qualifier ('of holiness') so it is kept separate; a reviewer may choose to fold it into the base concept if judged purely descriptive.
